commands:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1"
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.68" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/probe_env.py"
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
cd "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1" && nohup env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.68" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/bench_latency.py" --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --shapes 1x4096,1x8192,1x16384,2x8192,4x4096 --decode 128 --warmup 2 --iters 5 --tp 1 --pp 1 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-model-len 16640 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 64 --seed 0 --output "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1/results.jsonl" > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1/bench.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
n=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.static_batch.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); d=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.done.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); if pgrep -f '[b]ench_latency.py.*2026-09-30-qwen7b-static-longctx-node1' >/dev/null; then a=1; else a=0; fi; if [ "${d:-0}" -ge 1 ] && [ "${n:-0}" -ge 5 ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=${n:-0} alive=$a"
LAB_EOF

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF
